high_likelihood_missing_diagram_candidat.rationale: The statement asserts the fibre product for every diagram X to S from Y and gives affine charts Spec(B_ij tensor C_ik), while the facts specify the affine projections. A square makes the universal property and directions of maps explicit.

X → S and Y → S are the given maps
the two composites X×_S Y → S agree
the square is Cartesian; on affine pieces A→B, A→C induce B⊗_A C with b↦b⊗1 and c↦1⊗c
